name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Y'all, it's no contest. Hollow Da Don is the one that put the belt on Roc, made him the face of the URL. That's it.

name: TASHA RAW
line: But did one battle change his face inverse?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Inverse? Tasha, you're talking about a damn face lift. I'm talking about the moment he *became* the face of the URL. That's the whole damn story!

name: TASHA RAW
line: 'Face of the URL'? Been that for years, Marcus. But that week? That was the invoice. And it was stamped 'paid in full.'

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: An invoice? Nah, that was the coronation, my man. The whole damn league bowed down.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Cap.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The coronation was loud, but the invoice is what pays the mortgage. Rapverdict's own scorecards say the haymakers secured the two-one edge.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Right.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Neither is his moment, Marcus. This defines his legend.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: A single round can't carry a whole battle, Tasha. The record shows no consensus on his greatest battle.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Okay, 'definitely legendary.' Note the asterisks?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Okay, okay, asterisks? You're hung up on asterisks, Tasha. This was the crowning achievement, not just a footnote.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Crowding achievement doesn't pay the invoice though. Does it?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: You both talking about the receipt and the crown. The real question is: which one you can't tell the story without.

name: TASHA RAW
line: No. Story needs receipts. This one pays full price.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: A title is what they give you. A tape is what they replay. And the Hollow tape got replayed.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Rapverdict got receipts on that round. And his face got cemented. Which one disappears first?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The face gets cemented by the wave, but the legacy is built by the tide. And the tide of replay value... that's the Hollow tape.

name: TASHA RAW
line: But the seatbelt?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The seatbelt question is a distraction. The real measure is which battle you can't skip a round of. And with Hollow, nobody hits fast-forward.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Seatbelt defined him. You can't skip it.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: We talkin' about the seatbelt like it's the whole car. Rapverdict's own archives show no consensus on his single greatest battle, but they do show a two-one edge and a cemented position.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Again, not what archives say. Receipts say 'legendary' on the round. That's it.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: The archives say he edged it out, Tasha. That win made him the man for the league.

name: TASHA RAW
line: 'Edged it out.' And that's where you're stuck, Marcus. That round? It wasn't an edge. It was cement. His face, paid in full.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Cement is for sidewalks, Tasha. This was the heavyweight belt.
